deep.reconstruction:
The page has no mathematical derivation. There are a few faint, illegible formula fragments in the top margin. The rest is Riemann's natural-philosophical prose, in three blocks.

(A) Upper block, heavily revised. Certain phenomena (the referent is cut off; it is evidently gravitation and the non-locomotive changes of matter) are explained by assuming a substance (Stoff) that continuously fills all of space. This substance flows constantly into the ponderable atoms and disappears there. In equal times the amount that disappears is proportional to the mass (reading uncertain). Parallel psychological hypothesis: with every act of thought something lasting and substantial (Substantielles) enters the soul. It shows itself on special occasions, through memory, but has no lasting influence on the phenomena. The two hypotheses are merged into one: in all ponderable atoms Stoff continuously passes from the world of bodies into the world of mind (Geisteswelt). The cause of its disappearance there is the mental substance (Geistessubstanz) formed there immediately before. Ponderable bodies are therefore the place where the mental world acts on the bodily world. Footnote: this rests on Herbartian psychology, which ascribes substantiality not to the soul but to each individual representation (Vorstellung) formed in us.

(B) Middle block, numbered (112). This is an outline of the Newtonian framework: absolute space, absolute time, ponderable matter in definite states of motion, and forces acting at a distance (gravitation as the basis).
1) There exists an absolute space, and ponderable bodies referred to it change their place only continuously.
2) Motion is change, so a cause must be sought for it. The causes of motion of ponderable points are (a) their own state of motion, an internal cause with definite magnitude and direction (inertia), and (b) external forces.

(C) Lower block. On Newton's hypothesis, every point of space carries a cause with definite magnitude and direction: the resultant of all gravitational forces, g(x). It would give every ponderable point located there the same motion, i.e. acceleration is independent of the mass (my gloss: the equivalence of gravitational and inertial mass, a = g(x)). Riemann places this cause in the form of motion of the space-filling Stoff. He assumes the motion of the Stoff, by magnitude and direction, equals the force to be explained; schematically, velocity field v(x) = g(x). Consequently all actions of bodies on bodies across empty space must be propagated by this Stoff. The motions in which light and radiant heat consist, sent from one celestial body to another, must therefore also be motions of this same Stoff. Gravitation and light (motion) are the only phenomena that have to be explained through empty space alone. The page ends mid-sentence: 'I assume that the actual motion of the Stoff in empty space is composed of the…' The continuation on the next page decomposes the ether motion into a gradient (irrotational, gravitational) part and a part governed by a wave equation (light). It also sets up a variational integral with a divergence constraint and a Lagrange multiplier λ, with dm (ponderable mass) as a source.

Implicit physical content (my interpretation, not written on this page): if Stoff disappears at a rate proportional to mass, the steady inflow toward a point mass m has a radial sink velocity of size ∝ m/r². By continuity this reproduces the Newtonian 1/r² field, with div v = -4π·(density) as on the reverse/next page.
errors: No computational errors can be assessed: the page contains no derivation.
The faint formulas in the top margin are illegible and cannot be checked.
The physical identification 'velocity of the ether = gravitational force' is dimensionally loose (the units of velocity and acceleration differ). This is a modelling postulate rather than a slip.

results.what: Gravitation explained by a space-filling ether that flows into and disappears in ponderable atoms, at a rate proportional to mass; the ether's motion equals the gravitational force field.
results.modern_name: Ether-sink (fluid-sink) theory of gravitation; precursor of field-theoretic gravitation
results.usually_credited_to: Ether sink/flow ideas: Fatio/Le Sage-type mechanical theories, Euler; Riemann's version is published in his Werke ('Neue mathematische Principien der Naturphilosophie', 'Gravitation und Licht')

results.what: Unification hypothesis: matter disappearing into atoms equals entry of substance into the mental world; ponderable bodies are where Geisteswelt and Körperwelt interact; Herbartian substantiality of individual representations.
Gravitation and light (with radiant heat) as the only actions through empty space, both to be carried by one and the same medium.
results.modern_name: Unified ether for gravity and light; field-mediated action
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann's version is published; the general idea goes back to Faraday, Maxwell and others

results.what: Outline of Newtonian foundations: absolute space and time, continuity of motion, inertia, and the mass-independence of gravitational acceleration.
results.modern_name: Newtonian mechanics; equivalence of inertial and gravitational mass

deep.surprise_reason: This is a draft of the well-known Naturphilosophie fragments printed in Riemann's Gesammelte Werke (Weber/Dedekind 1876). Near-verbatim sentences appear there: the ponderable bodies as 'der Ort, wo die Geisteswelt in die Körperwelt eingreift', and the cause sought 'in der Bewegungsform eines den ganzen Raum stetig erfüllenden Stoffes'. The page offers only draft variants of known published text and contains no new mathematics.

checkable.sympy: x,y,z,m=symbols('x y z m',positive=True); r=sqrt(x**2+y**2+z**2); v=[-m*x/r**3,-m*y/r**3,-m*z/r**3]; simplify(diff(v[0],x)+diff(v[1],y)+diff(v[2],z))
checkable.asserts: Interpretive check: a radial sink flow of strength proportional to m has zero divergence away from the sink. Steady inflow of a vanishing ether therefore reproduces an inverse-square field (expected output 0).

checkable.sympy: x,y,z,m=symbols('x y z m',positive=True); r=sqrt(x**2+y**2+z**2); U=m/r; simplify(diff(U,x,2)+diff(U,y,2)+diff(U,z,2))
checkable.asserts: The Newtonian potential m/r is harmonic away from the source (expected 0); this is consistent with the -4π dm relation on the reverse page.

transcription_corrections: The opening line is probably 'Die letzteren erklären sich durch die Annahme eines den ganzen Weltraum stetig erfüllenden Stoffes'. The marginal 'Die s' is a separate fragment.
In the middle block, '{+absolute+} Abstossungskräfte' is doubtful. In the context of the Newtonian framework it more plausibly reads 'Anziehungskräfte' (attractive forces); the reading is uncertain.
'einen dauernden Einfluss auf die Erscheinungen nicht zeigt[?]' may read 'nicht zu zeigen' or 'nicht zu üben'; it is illegible in detail.
The top-margin formula fragments (faint, partly mirrored or show-through) are not transcribed and are illegible.
